Problem Statement:
Given two numbers N,K and an array of size N, print the three nearest neighbours of K(nearest neighbours are numbers which have least difference with K).
Input Description:
Input Size : 4 <= N, K <= 100000
Sample Input:
5 3
1 2 3 4 6
Sample Output:
2 4 1
